versions.changelog:
Major 4.0.0 update: Dual-engine prompt optimization with intelligent onboarding, granular platform adaptation, and persistent user preferences.

- Introduces a dual-engine system: 3,300+ prompt template library with LLM meta-prompting fallback.
- Intelligent onboarding asks first-time users about use case, engine, format, and template preferences.
- Auto-detects platform capabilities (file I/O & large file support) and downgrades features accordingly.
- User state (“on/off”, engine, format, selected categories) is persisted; can be changed with natural commands.
- Supports per-category template loading; reduces memory and token use.
- Adds multiple prompt optimization frameworks (general, analytical, iterative, query refinement).
- Supports optional prompt quality evaluation with scoring report.
- Only activates on explicit command; avoids general conversation or code review.
